text:
Eric Pohlkamp is six games into his NHL career and already has a goal, and it came in a wild 6-5 win in Utah on Saturday. The Sharks' 2023 fifth-round pick, 22, scored 18 goals as a defenseman at the University of Denver last season, and San Jose Hockey Now's game preview this month led with "praise for Pohlkamp."

The first week has gone well. Three points in six games, 15 and a half minutes a night, and the Sharks are almost five points better in shot share with him on than off. Six games is a tiny sample, and his teammates have scored about three goals more than their chances with him on, so the points are running ahead of the play.

He's 5-foot-11, and the scouting reports on undersized offensive defensemen tend to come down to the same question: can he defend enough to keep the minutes? His 11 blocked shots in six games suggest he's willing. Max Miller of Sharks Hockey Digest even noticed he'd switched from CCM gear to Warrior since his call-up. Small details, but this is a player whose story is just starting.
